aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the changed factor and omits key tested conditions, so it cannot be used as final evidence.
issues: Changed factor framed as VP mold #7/#8 vs no baseline, but source shows tests across molds and temperature conditions.
VP mold #4 evidence rows are ignored despite being visible test results.
Rows 26,27,29,30,32,33,35,36 are cited but not shown in context for verification of extracted values.
Outcome is labeled vision laser cutting, while decision emphasizes VP bending NG.
Test type, 1st molding, 2nd cure temperature, lot, and mold should be preserved as grouping keys.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor around test condition set: test type with 1st molding and 2nd cure temperature, keeping VP mold as subgroup unless evidence proves mold is primary.
Include all VP mold #4,#7,#8 rows for each test round.
Separate or clearly label laser cutting, bending, total NG, and downstream checks under one validation context.
Cite visible source rows for every extracted metric and condition.
Use the decision row to support the final judgement that tested conditions were not acceptable.
